Mars, the red planet. A world of iron deserts, buried engines, and roads that could carry my armies to the outer worlds. The Federation sees a neighbour to protect. I see the next foundation of an empire that will never ask permission to grow.

Darius would spend another year arguing over borders while his admirals congratulate themselves for keeping the peace. Let him argue. By the time his council agrees upon a response, our standards will already be rising over Martian ground.

And Vishara may watch from her distant throne, wrapped in all the ceremony her frozen court can muster. Her alliance will not hold this world for her. Every ship she sends to interfere will learn how far the reach of Terra Imperia extends.

Send the landing formations. Secure the approaches, establish our supply lines, and drive their forces from the positions they believed were safe. I want the orbital routes watched and our commanders reporting from the surface. We advance together, and we do not yield the ground we have taken.

Look upon Mars, commanders. No more petitions. No more speeches about restraint while our rivals strengthen their borders. A thousand soldiers stand ready to carry my answer across that red horizon. Give them their orders. SEIZE IT!
